summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and regulatory decisions affecting public order and retail inflation, alongside important funding news in the retail sector.

bullets.text: CJI Surya Kant declined a meeting with Rahul Gandhi, urging him to approach the court instead.
The Supreme Court found a prima facie contempt case regarding Delhi Metro restrictions during protests.
The Supreme Court ordered no detentions or restrictions during Delhi protests except as per law.
India's retail inflation is projected to rise to 5.47% in September, up from 4.82% in August, driven by food prices.
Nat Habit raised Rs 142 crore in Series C funding to expand its manufacturing capacity and reach 2 lakh stores.
